aboutGame.title: What is Skate Tree?
paragraphs: Skate Tree is a Roblox skateboarding game built around momentum rather than a flat skatepark. You ride a towering, branching tree, reading bark, branches, and roots to find lines, launch off ramps, and grind rails through the canopy. Every trick is a reward for the speed and angle you carried into it, so flow and clean landings matter far more than mashing inputs.

Progress converts time on the board into permanent unlocks. A branching skill tree gates new tricks, stats, and map areas, while first-time landings and challenges pay out the most points. Between runs you can redeem codes for free currency and cosmetics, then style your rider with decks, wheels, trails, and outfits. Skate Tree Wiki covers every system with practical guides, keybind tables, and spot-by-spot maps.

modules.name: Skate Tree Beginner Guide
modules.description: Get new players rolling with the essentials: controls, movement basics, a first-session routine, and the beginner mistakes that waste your first hour.

highlights.detail: Push and roll in a straight line to build consistent speed before anything else
Practice jumps and ollies on flat ground until five in a row land clean
Crouch before the lip, release at the edge, and land with the board straight
Approach rails nearly parallel and hold the grind without over-correcting
Reset fast after a bail and drill one new trick per run instead of ten
Spend early rewards on core stats and control, not flashy cosmetics

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Skate Tree.

items.question: What is Skate Tree?
items.answer: Skate Tree is a Roblox skateboarding game built around momentum on a towering, branching tree. You push, carve, and launch through the canopy, landing flips, grinds, and manuals to score. There are no races or classes to pick; your progress comes from a branching skill tree that unlocks new tricks, stats, and map areas.

items.question: Is Skate Tree free to play?
items.answer: Yes. Skate Tree is free to play on Roblox, and codes hand out free currency, cosmetics, and boosts without any purchase. Cosmetics are purely visual, so nothing behind a code changes how your board handles.

items.question: How do I get better at Skate Tree tricks?
items.answer: Treat momentum as currency. Bank speed on descents, straighten out before you trick, and add one input at a time until each move is boring. Exit Skate Tree grinds just before the surface ends, and keep moving so your combo does not decay.

items.question: Where can I find working Skate Tree codes?
items.answer: The newest Skate Tree codes usually appear first on the official game page, the developer Discord, and in-game news pop-ups. Community wikis are useful archives but lag on expiry, so redeem a code the same day you find it.

items.question: Which Skate Tree skill tree branch should I upgrade first?
items.answer: In Skate Tree, fund core stats before any trick branch, then go deep into flatground tricks because they anchor most combos. Add the grind branch next, and leave grab and air plus cosmetic nodes until your lines are consistent.
